original_technical_question: Distinguish observed cellular memory from adaptive causal usefulness under changing environments.

original_technical_question: Distinguish observed cellular memory from adaptive causal usefulness under changing environments.
principal_report: Bacillus response to shared starvation retains past-culture-state information in population reporters quantified by mutual information; fitness benefit unmeasured.
critical_caveat: Information extraction depends on defined history classes, clustering and population-averaged reporters; molecular cause, inherited ability and later fitness were not demonstrated.
reviewed_source_version: Public primary main text reviewed on 2026-10-08, complete off-page supplements not independently rerun

original_technical_question: Distinguish observed cellular memory from adaptive causal usefulness under changing environments.
principal_report: A theoretical derivation explains robust bacterial chemotaxis adaptation through integral feedback in an already existing methylation-controlled receptor system.
critical_caveat: Fixed previously evolved chemotaxis machinery is assumed; analytic adaptation under a defined regime is not de novo cognition or an independently reproduced organism.
reviewed_source_version: Public primary main text reviewed on 2026-10-08, complete off-page supplements not independently rerun

original_technical_question: Distinguish observed cellular memory from adaptive causal usefulness under changing environments.
principal_report: Engineered galactose yeast fast/slow phenotypic switching reverses which population grows better when environmental fluctuation frequency changes.
critical_caveat: Switch rates and environments artificially engineered and imposed; not evolving policy within a single cell.

original_technical_question: Distinguish observed cellular memory from adaptive causal usefulness under changing environments.
principal_report: An unreviewed theoretical preprint compares ordered versus random memory erasure and finds costly changes may help noisy worlds while harming abrupt sustained switches.
critical_caveat: NOT PEER REVIEWED and model-only; retention policies explicitly imposed by authors, not evolved in cellular worlds.

original_technical_question: Distinguish observed cellular memory from adaptive causal usefulness under changing environments.
principal_report: PRX Life authors report single E coli growth responses integrating nutrient history across minutes-to-hours microfluidic fluctuations.
critical_caveat: Author reused Nguyen et al 2021 data in Fig 1a, new MG1655 device experiments analyzed population averages of ~30000 nested cells per series; fractional memory strength EMA+sigmoid and ribosome subsector relaxation spectra are model structures, NOT direct experimentally reconstructed natural gates. Experimental data/model not reproduced.
reviewed_source_version: May 2026 PRX Life 4 023015 peer-reviewed full 14-page published PDF

original_technical_question: Distinguish observed cellular memory from adaptive causal usefulness under changing environments.
principal_report: Review of bacterial/yeast metabolic past-history behavior, lag times, epigenetic carryover and stochastic bet hedging.
critical_caveat: Literature review overlaps earlier experiments and should not be counted as independent experimental evidence.

original_technical_question: Distinguish observed cellular memory from adaptive causal usefulness under changing environments.
principal_report: BioRxiv v1 reports 341 temporally changing Stentor genes and five PKG paralogs during habituation, offering candidate signaling pathways.
critical_caveat: NOT PEER REVIEWED, expression associations not gene knockout causality, investigator overlap with prior Stentor group studies.

original_technical_question: Can heritable changes recruit preexisting latent physical modes without new reaction primitives, and do they yield useful ecological behavior?
principal_report: Full molecular follow-up to previously evolved Pseudomonas bet-hedging switches; inherited changes expose pre-existing metabolic bistability at a cost, with specific network-context dependence.
critical_caveat: Overlapping same original switching lineage as Beaumont 2009, new molecular intervention not independent second origin. full 2015 PLOS Biology main text, relevant figures, source provenance and methods; related older 2009 history reused, supplemental raw not reproduced
reviewed_source_version: 2015 public original main peer-reviewed article

original_technical_question: Measure resource-conserving readiness/lag cost and distinguish prior physiology from learned intelligence.
principal_report: Nutrient transitions in E coli expose current-growth versus future-readiness trade-offs; enzyme readiness perturbations causally alter subsequent lag within mature inherited metabolism.
critical_caveat: 144 nutrient source/destination transitions are conditions, not independent evolved organism origins. complete public Nature accepted main manuscript, metabolic assay and genotype control figures, discussion; supplements/source data not independently reanalyzed
reviewed_source_version: 2020 public original main peer-reviewed article

original_technical_question: Distinguish a newly evolved heritable switching strategy from a pre-engineered phenotype-switch controller.
principal_report: Experimental selection under alternating phenotypic requirements produced de novo stochastic switching in two of twelve Pseudomonas evolution populations, contingent on genetic history.
critical_caveat: Original Pseudomonas populations reexamined in Gallie 2015; do not double count. primary Nature publisher abstract and official figure/source summaries reviewed, original full paper/supplements not independently audited

original_technical_question: Separate evolved population-genotype risk spreading from within-cell experience-based changes and avoid bioengineering of antibiotic tolerance.
principal_report: Published evolution study reports E coli populations evolved inherited delayed regrowth proportional to historical duration of a transient selective stress, with antibiotic resistance distinct from tolerance.
critical_caveat: Distinct selected antibiotic experiment, not a direct replication of Beaumont switching or Gallie metabolic network. primary Nature abstract, PubMed and selected published figure descriptions; complete original main methods not read to E2

original_technical_question: Identify evolutionary hysteresis and slow reversal of inherited survival strategies, without treating antibiotic persistence as cognitive memory.
principal_report: Evolution of E coli population persistence responds to treatment frequency; reversal to low persistence after selection cessation was slower and incomplete.
critical_caveat: Distinct treatment-frequency evolution study; cannot pool with Fridman 2014 conditions without matched design. primary Nature Microbiology abstract, PubMed metadata and figure summaries; full main methods not audited

original_technical_question: Distinguish real change in long-lived physiological states from an observer-defined response/measurement-time artifact.
principal_report: A single stationary E coli population appeared to contain different fractions of persister cells depending on medium-driven awakening kinetics during measurement.
critical_caveat: Single source culture compared across new-media assay conditions, not independent evolution origins. primary 2010 Journal of Bacteriology public abstract and selected main results; complete main source not independently audited to E2
